text:
rachel: Heads-up — Chen Li (new hire) starts Wed remote (Seattle). Two blockers: 1) BG shows SSN mismatch, vendor asked for supporting docs; 2) I-9 needs authorized agent because she can't make it to SF office during week one. Can we coordinate options?

omar: Do we have preferred vendor for authorized agents in Seattle? UPS stores accepted by USCIS?

bg-vendor: Vendor note: SSN on candidate record 'XXX-XX-1234' vs DOJ check returned different last 4. Candidate must provide SSN card image or payroll report within 72 hrs for resolution.

elaine: I can ping Chen to request SSN card upload + a utility bill to confirm address. If Chen can't get that soon, plan B = use a notary/authorized agent for I-9 and provisional access.

chen: I can upload a scan tonight. I also live near a UPS store that lists an "Authorized I-9 agent" option. Happy to use that if needed.

it-ops: For provisional access, we can issue an escorted laptop pickup at coworking space and create a time-limited SSH/VPN profile (no prod access). Need manager sign-off and INFRA ticket. Expires in 5 days.

omar: Manager sign-off (omar) OK if BG unresolved. Please add security checklist.

reception-bot: Note: Seattle office does not have staffed reception on Wednesdays. Badge staging not available on Wed. Alternative: badge courier drop at coworking or ship to candidate.

courier-bot: Courier option: ship welcome crate overnight with signature required or hold at FedEx/UPS store for pickup. Cost estimate $18. If delivering to UPS store, candidate must present ID.

rachel: If vendor clears BG before Wed 10am, proceed with standard onboarding and digital badge. If not, plan UPS authorized agent for I-9 at 11:00 Wed and courier hold at UPS Store #4421 (Chen pickup).

bg-vendor: Candidate uploaded SSN card at 21:05 PST. Under review. Estimated resolution 4-8 hrs.

elaine: Good. In parallel I'll tentatively book UPS agent slot Wed 11:00 just in case. If not needed, we'll cancel.

chen: One question — payroll needs W-4 + direct deposit. Can I fill online or do you need physical forms?

it-ops: Link to payroll portal sent via DM. You can submit W-4 and bank details online. If you prefer paper, courier can include enrollment forms in crate.

rachel: Manifest for courier/UPS hold if we need physical packet:
```
manifest:
- laptop (MBP 13) serial redacted
- charger
- temporary badge: CHEN-552
- benefits packet (paper)
- payroll W-4 (paper copy)
- welcome letter
```

omar: Security request: create temporary VPN profile 'chen-temp' with MFA, no access to prod infra, expires in 5 days. IT please confirm when created.

it-ops: Created ticket INF-4621. Temp profile ready to toggle on after manager approval.

rachel: OK. If BG clears before 09:00 Wed, we cancel UPS slot and just ship to Chen's address. If BG still pending at 09:00, proceed with UPS authorized agent at 11:00 and courier hold.

(bg-vendor bot posts status: resolved at 02:12 UTC)

bg-vendor: Background check resolved: SSN verified. No record flags. Clearance timestamp 02:12 UTC.

rachel: Great — cancel UPS hold. Courier ship to: Chen Li, 2209 Pine St Apt 4, Seattle, WA 98101. Mark SIGNATURE_OPTIONAL and include benefits packet. ETA Wed by 12:30 local.

courier-bot: Label created TRK-998877. Scheduled overnight, delivery Wed 11:45 PST. Signature optional.

chen: Thanks team — uploading W-4 now and accepted the welcome calendar invite. See you Wed 10:00 for orientation Zoom.

elainE: (typo but short) Awesome welcome!

(rachel reacts :tada:)
